sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The recurrent seasonal ozone hole occurs over Antarctica in Southern Hemisphere spring. Arctic loss can be significant, including exceptional2020, but the source distinguishes it from an extensive recurrent Antarctic hole. Each spring is a contemporary recurring phenomenon, not a claim for all geological/historical years. Unqualified Russian spring means local spring of the named polar region; explanation explicitly resolves Southern Hemisphere. Four geographic alternatives are real and grammatically parallel; Greenland/Alaska are credible north-versus-south confusions, not extra correct annual-hole regions.
